title: Explorer navigation bar
responsibility: Provides repository, category, revision and scoped entity navigation.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.modules
inputs.description: Optional source catalog used to populate Code resource tabs. Defaults to undefined (omitted); when omitted, harnessShell falls back to standardCodeModules, treating those definitions as installed, and displayed resources must be installed and not marked testing.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.base
inputs.description: The explorer mount path used for the brand link when no branch is resolved and as the search link fallback when an entity has no route.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.repository
inputs.description: The repository label shown in the header when it is truthy. A null or empty string hides the repository segment.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.scope
inputs.description: The resolved explorer location and revision context used to build category targets, module tabs, revision state and search. When null, module destinations and revision state are absent, and search is not rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.index
inputs.description: The repository index passed to revision selectors. The selectors render only when a revision exists and this value is non-null.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.commits
inputs.description: The branch revision choices in newest-first order. harnessShell prepends the viewed revision summary when its commit is absent from this list.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.href
inputs.description: Formats an explorer location as a complete address including the mount. The shell uses it for navigation links and search uses it for a matching entity destination.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.onroute
inputs.description: Receives locations from plain primary link clicks and selected module, branch, commit or search destinations. Modified, non-primary or already-prevented link clicks retain normal browser behavior.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.search
inputs.description: Optional entities available to scoped search, or null while the host reads them. Defaults to undefined (omitted); search is rendered only when scope exists and the entries are discarded if any entry commit differs from the current scope commit.

outputs.name: HarnessNavbar
outputs.description: Header markup contains the brand and category navigation, with a repository label, module tabs, revision selectors, historical status and entity search under their respective conditions. Historical status appears only for a viewed revision labeled 'Historical commit'; search requires a scope, and revision selectors also require an index.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Exceptions from supplied href or onroute callbacks propagate when those callbacks are invoked. This component does not catch them or provide an error boundary.
